# Nested body tables and page stories

Original fixture generated by `tools/nested_table_stories_fixture.py`, with
three explicit body pages, nested two-row tables, six blue inline pictures,
and separate first/even/default headers and footers. Headers have four, three,
and two lines respectively, exceeding the declared body top margin.

`native.pdf` was exported read-only by the reference application.
`tools/nested_table_stories_reference.py` extracts native picture origins and
records source/PDF hashes in `reference.json`. No corpus content is used.

This catches physical header-bound callbacks leaking into intrinsic nested
table measurement before logical page numbers exist. Such measurement must
remain independent of page-story selection; actual pagination must still use
the first/even/default physical bounds. See ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.4.65 (`tc`)
and §17.6.11 (`pgMar`). Browser checks compare all six picture origins with
the reference application and exercise no-edit retention, editing, exact undo, and reopening.

Measured native differences: x and width agree exactly; the largest vertical
difference is 0.00391pt. The regression tolerance is 0.2pt for native PDF rounding.
